text:
sarah_cs: Quick synthesis from 6 onboarding calls this week — common asks we should capture for product: per-route usage/cost visibility, sample prompt templates for regulated domains, an admin guided onboarding checklist, and renewal-risk alerts for usage drops. Putting here to decide prioritization.

mike_pm: Thanks — can you share counts and which accounts? Any tied to renewals this quarter?

sarah_cs: 4 paying accounts mentioned per-route visibility. ParkCo and Helix are up for renewal in ~45–60 days. I'll paste raw notes below.

sam_csm: Raw snippets: ParkCo — "we can't attribute cost per feature, need per-route breakouts"; Helix — "would love an admin wizard for onboarding devs and sample prompts".

aj_dev: Per-route cost visibility sounds like telemetry + aggregation + UI. Could do a CSV-export MVP first to unblock CS. Backend ~2 dev-days, frontend another 2.

tess_eng: I can spike the export. Suggest adding a usage_by_route table in events store. Quick query: ```SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM requests WHERE customer_id = 'parkco' GROUP BY route;```

mike_pm: Spike + mock UI makes sense. Priority: renewal-risk accounts first. @sarah_cs can ParkCo be an early adopter?

sarah_cs: ParkCo said yes if ETA < 6 weeks. High priority from them.

product-bot: Reminder: please add feature request to product board with customer impact tags — https://productboard.example/redwood :memo:

aj_dev: Also can bundle sample prompt templates in onboarding package (templates/v1) for customers in regulated spaces. Low effort to add to the UI.

sam_csm: :thumbsup: I'll book a 30m call with ParkCo to confirm scope and ask about billing granularity (hourly vs daily). They specifically asked for hourly in one call.

tess_eng: For renewal-risk alerts we can add a monitor: if week-over-week tokens drop > 30% AND error rate > 2% -> flag account. I can add that to monitors as a rule.

mike_pm: Proposed plan: 1) CS validates scope with ParkCo/Helix (sarah/sam) 2) Eng spikes (tess/aj) with CSV export + quick query 3) PM creates productboard entry & triage (mike) 4) Ship alpha to ParkCo in ~6 weeks. Agree?

sarah_cs: Agree. I'll DM ParkCo and update this thread by EOD with their confirmation.

sam_csm: Also capturing: request for "admin-only guided walkthrough" and a checklist for security/compliance steps.

mike_pm: Noted. Thanks team :rocket:
